about: The phone's only filter (decision 0049): a message whose title or text holds one of these keywords (folded: lower case, Arabic letter variants, no diacritics) is sent; anything else stays on the phone. The list must equal CAPTURE_KEYWORDS in api/lib/capture/intake.ts and CaptureGate.DEFAULT_KEYWORDS (checked by api/lib/capture/phone-gate-fixtures.test.ts and the Kotlin test). Invented messages: the repository is public.

cases.name: an English card purchase is sent
cases.text: Your card was charged EGP 85.00 at ZED MARKET

cases.name: an Arabic debit is sent
cases.text: تم خصم 340 جنيه من بطاقتك لدى صيدلية

cases.name: a written hamza variant still matches (ايداع)
a taa marbuta variant still matches (بطاقه)
Arabic diacritics do not hide a word
upper case does not hide a word
a title alone can carry the word
cases.title: Transaction alert

cases.name: a one-time code that names a purchase is sent (the server drops it)
cases.text: Your OTP for the purchase of EGP 799 is 482913

cases.name: a personal chat without a keyword is not sent
a delivery update without a keyword is not sent
cases.text: Your order is out for delivery

cases.name: a code without a keyword is not sent
